cases.name: D112: a workshop gets .mcp.json with the server orkeon running orkeon-mcp, and settings.local.json enables it; a second synchronisation writes nothing more
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; mkdir -p "$F/bin"; printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$F/bin/orkeon-mcp"; chmod +x "$F/bin/orkeon-mcp"; export PATH="$F/bin:$PATH" HARNESS_ORKEON_MCP=1
w=$F/w; mkws "$w"; out=$(sy "$w") || fail "$out"
[ "$(jq -c . "$w/.mcp.json")" = '{"mcpServers":{"orkeon":{"command":"orkeon-mcp","args":[]}}}' ] || fail "mcp: $(cat "$w/.mcp.json")"
[ "$(jq -c .enabledMcpjsonServers "$w/.claude/settings.local.json")" = '["orkeon"]' ] || fail "local: $(cat "$w/.claude/settings.local.json")"
a=$(snap "$w"); out=$(sy "$w") || fail "$out"; [ "$a" = "$(snap "$w")" ] || fail "second run wrote: $out"
printf ok

cases.name: D112: a workshop made before - a .mcp.json of the user and a settings.local.json with keys, mode 0600 - keeps both: the entry is added beside the user's server, the list beside the env block, the mode kept
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; mkdir -p "$F/bin"; printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$F/bin/orkeon-mcp"; chmod +x "$F/bin/orkeon-mcp"; export PATH="$F/bin:$PATH" HARNESS_ORKEON_MCP=1
w=$F/w; mkws "$w"; mkdir -p "$w/.claude"; printf '{"mcpServers":{"mine":{"command":"x"}},"other":1}\n' > "$w/.mcp.json"; printf '{"env":{"OPENAI_API_KEY":"k"},"enableAllProjectMcpServers":false}\n' > "$w/.claude/settings.local.json"; chmod 600 "$w/.claude/settings.local.json"
out=$(sy "$w") || fail "$out"
[ "$(jq -c . "$w/.mcp.json")" = '{"mcpServers":{"mine":{"command":"x"},"orkeon":{"command":"orkeon-mcp","args":[]}},"other":1}' ] || fail "mcp: $(cat "$w/.mcp.json")"
[ "$(jq -c . "$w/.claude/settings.local.json")" = '{"env":{"OPENAI_API_KEY":"k"},"enableAllProjectMcpServers":false,"enabledMcpjsonServers":["orkeon"]}' ] || fail "local: $(cat "$w/.claude/settings.local.json")"
[ "$(stat -c %a "$w/.claude/settings.local.json")" = 600 ] || fail "mode $(stat -c %a "$w/.claude/settings.local.json")"
printf ok

cases.name: D112: the user's no is kept - orkeon in disabledMcpjsonServers is not enabled, an entry orkeon the user changed is left as it is, and HARNESS_ORKEON_MCP=0 writes nothing at all
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; mkdir -p "$F/bin"; printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$F/bin/orkeon-mcp"; chmod +x "$F/bin/orkeon-mcp"; export PATH="$F/bin:$PATH" HARNESS_ORKEON_MCP=1
w=$F/w; mkws "$w"; mkdir -p "$w/.claude"; printf '{"mcpServers":{"orkeon":{"command":"my-own"}}}\n' > "$w/.mcp.json"; printf '{"disabledMcpjsonServers":["orkeon"]}\n' > "$w/.claude/settings.local.json"
out=$(sy "$w") || fail "$out"
[ "$(jq -c . "$w/.mcp.json")" = '{"mcpServers":{"orkeon":{"command":"my-own"}}}' ] || fail "mcp: $(cat "$w/.mcp.json")"
[ "$(jq -c . "$w/.claude/settings.local.json")" = '{"disabledMcpjsonServers":["orkeon"]}' ] || fail "local: $(cat "$w/.claude/settings.local.json")"
v=$F/v; mkws "$v"; out=$(HARNESS_ORKEON_MCP=0 sy "$v") || fail "$out"; [ ! -e "$v/.mcp.json" ] || fail "off: .mcp.json written"
printf 'x' > "$F/bad.json"; u=$F/u; mkws "$u"; cp "$F/bad.json" "$u/.mcp.json"; out=$(sy "$u") || fail "$out"; printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF '.mcp.json is not a JSON object' || fail "$out"; [ "$(cat "$u/.mcp.json")" = x ] || fail 'bad json rewritten'
printf ok

cases.name: D112: in a checkout the harness writes .mcp.json only when git does not track one - then lists it in the exclude block, git status clean - and never touches the repository's own
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; mkdir -p "$F/bin"; printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$F/bin/orkeon-mcp"; chmod +x "$F/bin/orkeon-mcp"; export PATH="$F/bin:$PATH" HARNESS_ORKEON_MCP=1
r=$F/r; mkrepo "$r" https://github.com/acme/thing.git
out=$(HARNESS_PROFILE=dev sy "$r") || fail "$out"
[ "$(jq -r .mcpServers.orkeon.command "$r/.mcp.json")" = orkeon-mcp ] || fail "no .mcp.json: $out"
[ -z "$(git -C "$r" status --porcelain)" ] || fail "status: $(git -C "$r" status --porcelain)"
grep -qx '/.mcp.json' "$r/.git/info/exclude" || fail exclude
out=$(sy "$r") || fail "$out"; [ -z "$(git -C "$r" status --porcelain)" ] || fail "second status: $(git -C "$r" status --porcelain)"
q=$F/q; mkrepo "$q" https://github.com/acme/thing.git; printf '{"mcpServers":{}}\n' > "$q/.mcp.json"; git -C "$q" add .mcp.json; git -C "$q" "${GITC[@]}" commit -qm mcp
out=$(HARNESS_PROFILE=dev sy "$q") || fail "$out"
[ "$(jq -c . "$q/.mcp.json")" = '{"mcpServers":{}}' ] || fail "tracked file written"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF ".mcp.json is the repository's" || fail "$out"
[ -z "$(git -C "$q" status --porcelain)" ] || fail "q status: $(git -C "$q" status --porcelain)"
grep -qx '/.mcp.json' "$q/.git/info/exclude" && fail 'tracked file excluded'
printf ok

cases.name: D112: orkeon-mcp serves a short list crossed with what orkeon has - a tool this Orkeon lacks is left out with a line, never the file, edit or shell tools, web_search only with its key - and mounts the folder read-write at an index no settings file uses

V-64: what orkeon mcp serve writes reaches Claude Code without its null-valued keys - no "error": null beside a result, no "result": null beside an error, no null nextCursor, mimeType or data, which Claude Code's MCP client refuses (the handshake then times out) - while a tool's answer, a string, keeps its text, a parse error's answer keeps its null id and a line that is no JSON goes through as it is

V-65: from the sources of 1.3.0 on (Orkeon#405) orkeon mcp serve writes no null member, and orkeon-mcp hands its stream over as it is, without the filter of V-64 - a null a tool's result carries on purpose stays, the parse error's null id too - while an Orkeon that names no version, or an older one, keeps the filter
